description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeSalary class within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes properties such as employee, pay grade, currency type, amount, pay period, salary name, comments, and direct debit details. The class provides getter and setter methods for each property, encapsulating employee salary information and ORM configuration.

classes.name: EmployeeSalary
classes.description: Represents an employee's salary record with ORM mappings, including relationships to employee, pay grade, currency, pay period, and direct debit, as well as salary details like amount and comments.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the salary record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the salary record.

methods.name: getPayGrade
methods.description: Returns the PayGrade entity if assigned.

methods.name: getCurrencyType
methods.description: Returns the CurrencyType associated with the salary.

methods.name: setCurrencyType
methods.description: Sets the CurrencyType for the salary.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the salary amount as a string.

methods.name: getPayPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the PayPeriod associated with the salary.

methods.name: getSalaryName
methods.description: Returns the name of the salary component.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves any comments related to the salary.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets comments for the salary record.

methods.name: getDirectDebit
methods.description: Returns the EmpDirectDebit entity if present.
